remark:
As per the point 4 of permission/approval letter, for the purpose of development, an additional B.A.R. area of 5644.20 sq. m. has been availed for the development of the project. Out of the same, 8 units having a total area of 846.18 sq. m., equivalent to a minimum of 15% of the area (846.63 sq. m.), comprising Unit/Flat Nos. 105–107, 205, 206, 306, 307 and 406, have been mortgage with the Jaipur development Authority towards compliance of the betterment levy condition. 
Further as per point no. 5, if the prescribed Betterment Levy amount is not deposited within the stipulated period, the local body shall take possession of the mortgaged units and shall be entitled to recover the amount due by selling the said units. It is mandatory to obtain a Mortgage Free Letter from the local body after depositing the Betterment Levy amount along with applicable interest, if any. Until such Mortgage Free Letter is obtained, the mortgaged units cannot be booked, sold, transferred, or mortgaged to any other person, authority, or entity.
